justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java. The target is a small nested interface at lines 4570-4598 with only two responsibilities, `resolveSuperClass` and `resolveInterfaceTypes`, and a single concrete implementation `ForType.Tokenized` at lines 4603-4668. Its third related operation, `resolveTypeVariables`, is already separated into the sibling `Resolution` interface and is implemented by other nested variants (`Raw`, `Malformed`). The surrounding code also splits field/method/record-component handling into separate nested interfaces (`ForField`, `ForMethod`, `ForRecordComponent`), so `ForType` looks like a focused abstraction rather than an insufficiently modular class.
